concerns.text: The plan lists SC-008 (ΔR² between 2‑D‑only model and a 3‑D baseline) as a required success criterion, yet Constitution Principle VI explicitly forbids any use of 3‑D descriptors. The plan also marks FR‑010/011 (3‑D baseline) as out‑of‑scope, creating a logical contradiction: the validation target (ΔR²) cannot be computed because the required 3‑D model is disallowed. This makes the research question unanswerable as written and constitutes a science‑class defect.
